attenuation_color.description: Linear RGB light remaining after attenuation_distance through a transmissive volume.

attenuation_distance.description: Absorption distance in world meters for volume transmission. Omit for no volume absorption. Requires positive thickness.

base_color.description: Linear RGBA, multiplied by vertex color and optional sRGB texture.

base_color_texture.description: PNG or JPEG, relative to recipe; embedded in GLB.

double_sided.description: Disable back-face culling for thin leaves/cards.

ior.description: Dielectric index of refraction, exported with KHR_materials_ior when non-default. E.g. diamond 2.42. Does not model dispersion.

metallic_roughness_texture.description: Linear packed texture, roughness in G, metallic in B.

subsurface.description: Burley surface diffusion weight in the Blender preview. Saved in GLB foliageutil extras.

subsurface_radius.description: Positive RGB scattering radius ratios, multiplied by subsurface_scale.

subsurface_scale.description: Surface diffusion scale in meters in the Blender preview.

thickness.description: Approximate volume thickness in mesh meters for refractive GLB materials. Positive values require transmission and a closed mesh; ray tracers use the actual surface distance.

translucency.description: Thin-surface diffuse transmission weight, separate from alpha coverage. Saved in GLB foliageutil extras; applied by the Blender preview adapter.

translucency_color.description: Linear RGB transmission tint, multiplied by textured base color in the Blender preview.

transmission.description: Optical transmission through glass or gems. Exports KHR_materials_transmission; independent of alpha coverage and thin-tissue translucency. Requires a compatible viewer shader.
